## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

One-juan early-Yuán *yǔlù* of **Hǎiyìn Zhāorú** [昭如](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%AD%E5%A6%82) 海印昭如, Yángqí-branch Línjì master, dharma-heir of [祖欽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%96%E6%AC%BD) Xuěyán Zǔqīn. *Xuzangjing* X70 n1398. Preface by Sūn Xùnshēn 曾巽申 (Hànlín Guóshǐyuàn biānxiū 翰林國史院編修) dated Yányòu 4.7 (August–September 1317) — the preface states that in Zhìdà *wùshēn* (1308) summer Zhāorú led a Yúlánpén offering for Xùnshēn's mother. Three abbacy records: Yuánzhōu Mùpíng Xīnghuà 木平興化, Línjiāng Ruìyúnshān Huìlì 瑞筠山慧力, and Ráozhōu Dōnghú Jiànsì 東湖薦[福] — followed by *sònggǔ*, *jìsòng*, *fózǔ zàn*, etc. Compiled by three dharma-heirs: [行純](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A1%8C%E7%B4%94) Xíngchún, [道彰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%BD%B0) Dàozhāng, and [從心](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E5%BF%83) Cóngxīn. The preface compares Zhāorú's role to Zhàntáng Wénzhǔn 湛堂文準's at the close of the Northern Sòng — "my master today's Zhàntáng."
